description: Reviewed classification of every unique --unfreed=warn missing-free site and every local suppression in the M2 pilots (M2.3). Classes: invocation-lifetime (intentional retention to process exit), temporary-cleanup (work left to retire), proof-limit (a diagnostic or proof limit).

sites.message: allocation assigned to 'kernel' leaves scope without being freed
sites.justification: OwnershipKernel holds the analyzer's input nodes and slots, the tracker and the evidence store; nodes and their versions are invocation-lived under D262 and the adapter exits after writing its result

sites.message: allocation assigned to 'kernel' leaves scope without being freed
sites.justification: EvidenceKernel holds the evidence store, its budget and the colliding nodes whose sites, events and joins are invocation-lived evidence payloads under D262

sites.message: allocation assigned to 'kernel' leaves scope without being freed
sites.justification: InputKernel owns the span and type that the rejected IR inputs borrow; admitted IR is invocation-lived under D262, and so are inputs rejected before analysis

sites.message: allocation assigned to 'node' leaves scope without being freed
sites.justification: an allocation node is an invocation-lived analyzer input under D262; this one carries the freed input state the factory rejects

suppressions.justification: the shared sentinel for a parse that threw is stored in the retained result list and lives to process exit (D261 test adapter)
